old: relativity, nuance, non-absoluteness
new: relativity
why: gloss: "nuance" is árnyalás; "non-absoluteness" is invented

old: aspect, point of view, criteria
new: aspect, consideration, criterion
why: gloss: "point of view" also glosses álláspont

old: weighing, deliberation, consideration
new: weighing up, deliberation
why: gloss: "consideration" also glosses szempont

old: nuance, qualification, shading of meaning
new: nuance, shading of meaning
why: gloss: "qualification" is repeated on three words

old: stipulation, qualification, reservation
new: condition, stipulation
why: gloss: "reservation" belongs to fenntartás

old: reservation, qualification, doubt
new: reservation, doubt
why: gloss: "qualification" is repeated

old: I support the proposal with the reservation that implementation remains transparent.
new: I support the proposal, but I have one reservation: the implementation must be transparent.
why: english line of the changed example

old: Insofar as all parties follow the rules, the agreement will be successful.
new: If all parties follow the rules, the agreement will be successful.
why: amennyiben means "if" (A2 Unit 13), not "insofar as"

old: We refute the finding according to which the intervention was delayed.
new: We refute the claim that the intervention came too late.
why: english line of the changed example

old: In my view, the issue is far more complex than to decide hastily.
new: In my view, the question is more complex than we think.
why: english line of the changed example

old: I can construct multi-level nested opinion clauses with explanatory conjunctions.
new: I can give an opinion and a reason with azt gondolom, hogy … mert ….
why: the lesson practises one opinion plus one reason, not "multi-level" clauses

old: I can master 4 core vocabulary terms for intellectual viewpoints.
new: I can say what álláspont, érvelés, meglátás and véleménynyilvánítás mean.
why: vague "master 4 terms"

old: I can state well-grounded personal opinions with confidence.
new: I can say úgy vélem, hogy … and meglátásom szerint … for my own view.
why: goal promises more than the lesson practises

old: I can acquire 4 vocabulary terms for deliberation and balance.
new: I can say what szempont, mérlegelés and egyensúly mean.
why: viszonylagosság is never practised

old: I can conduct fair-minded comparative assessments in Hungarian.
new: I can name the two sides of a question with egyfelől … másfelől ….
why: goal promises more than the lesson practises

old: I can qualify opinions by attaching conditions with azzal a fenntartással and amennyiben.
new: I can attach a condition to my agreement with amennyiben, or name a reservation with fenntartás.
why: azzal a fenntartással removed from the lesson (B2 anchor family)

old: I can use 4 vocabulary terms for qualifications and reservations.
new: I can say what árnyalás, kivétel and fenntartás mean.
why: megkötés is never practised

old: I can articulate nuanced positions that avoid simplistic black-and-white claims.
new: I can say that a rule has an exception.
why: goal promises more than the lesson practises

old: I can reinforce my arguments with certainty disjuncts like kétségkívül and vitathatatlanul.
new: I can say that something is certain with kétségkívül and vitathatatlanul.
why: "disjuncts" is jargon

old: I can deploy 4 terms for counterarguments and proof.
new: I can say what ellenérv, meggyőződés, bizonyítás and cáfolat mean.
why: vague

old: I can defend my perspective in a structured debate.
new: I can answer a claim with ezzel szemben úgy tartom, hogy ….
why: goal promises more than the lesson practises

old: I can summarize complex arguments using mindent egybevetve and a fentiek tükrében.
new: I can sum up a discussion with mindent egybevetve and a fentiek tükrében.
why: "complex arguments" is more than a one-sentence summary

old: I can soften statements with pragmatic hedging formulas like meglátásom szerint.
new: I can soften what I say with meglátásom szerint.
why: jargon

old: I can learn 4 words for synthesis, compromise, and moral conclusions.
new: I can say what összegzés, kompromisszum, tanulság and végkövetkeztetés mean.
why: vague

old: I can read and analyze an adaptation of Babits Mihály's psychological masterpiece A gólyakalifa.
new: I can read a short scene from Babits Mihály's A gólyakalifa and answer a question about it.
